subject: science
concept: Using your five senses to make careful observations
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Asking Questions, Planning Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a real or virtual object and describes it using each of the five senses
exercise.pictorial: Student matches sensory words (rough, loud, sweet) to pictured objects that fit them
exercise.abstract: Student lists observations about an object using only what they directly sensed, not assumptions

misconception_flags: states an assumption or guess as if it were a direct observation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
